The front bumper cover is cracked across the center and the radiator support shows bending consistent with a low-speed frontal
strike, and most of the visible damage lines up well with the impact described. Some of the damage can be traced directly to that

however, run roughly three times what this scope of repair would normally require, and the plan should be reviewed before
approval. A few older scratches along the driver side door appear to predate this collision and should be excluded from the scope.
The recommended plan is to replace the bumper cover, repair the radiator support, and refinish the affected panels, with the labor
hours revised downward.
